title: Rohan's personal emergency bag / community transfer kit
framing: Rohan's personal emergency bag and community transfer kit for home, school, and public DisabilityFour events. Paid trained responders use the kit; family/Jay are not the inventory owners as unpaid clinicians. Not generic hospital stock.
